project_type: React 19 SPA + Vite 7 + Tailwind v4, PWA via vite-plugin-pwa. No backend — new lightweight Node http server added alongside.
build_system: Vite 7 — `npm run build` in c:\Users\KING\number-academy produces dist/. Zero config quirks besides the PWA plugin. Node server (server.js) is run separately with `node server.js`, not bundled by Vite.
test_framework: None. Verification = `npm run build` (zero errors) + `node --check <file>` for generated JS files.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `node --check c:\Users\KING\number-academy\src\data\curriculumData.js` — must exit 0. 2. Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\KING\number-academy — must complete with 'built in Xms' and zero error lines.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Workspace root: c:\Users\KING\number-academy. All file paths must be absolute or relative to that root. No new npm packages. No new devDependencies.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md. Follow existing conventions: named exports for components, default exports for pages, Tailwind design tokens only (bg-card, bg-paper, border-line, text-ink, text-ink-soft, text-accent, rounded-xl), mobile-first, pb-24 bottom padding on pages.
key_patterns: 1. curriculumMap[subjectId][classId] → strand[] with {id,code,title,subStrands:[{id,code,title,contentStandards:[{id,code,description,indicators:[{id,code,description}]}]}]}. 2. Dexie db singleton in src/db/database.js — currently at version(3). 3. useLiveQuery for reactive reads. 4. Modal pattern: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center overlay; bg-card rounded-xl panel. 5. Slide-up drawer: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50, translate-y transforms for open/close. 6. Button.jsx: variant='primary'|'secondary'|'ghost'. 7. AppShell Outlet rendered in <main> with max-w-5xl, BottomNav fixed at bottom. 8. BottomNav has 5 tabs: Home, Planner, Curriculum, Progress, Profile — all 5 slots occupied so AI Assistant gets NO bottom nav tab; it is reachable via App.jsx route + deep link from Curriculum page. 9. Spinner: lucide-react Loader2 with animate-spin. 10. Error display: text-red-500 small text. 11. PlannerLesson renderSlide() pattern: each step key returns a <div> with textarea + helpers.
directory_structure: src/db/ — Dexie v3 schema; src/data/ — static curriculumData.js + curriculum/*.md; src/pages/ — one file per route; src/components/layout/ — AppShell + BottomNav; src/components/ui/ — Button, Card; src/services/ — NEW ai.js; scripts/ — NEW parse-curriculum.mjs; server.js — NEW Node proxy at root; .env.example — NEW at root.
critical_edge_cases: 1. CREATIVE_ARTS_AND_DESIGN and CCP_MATHEMATICS_JHS_2023 markdown files are empty stubs (0 strands, content table has no rows). Parser must gracefully produce empty arrays for these subjects. 2. Existing curriculumData.js already has mathematics B7 and science B7 data that must be PRESERVED (merged, not overwritten). 3. Mathematics B8/B9 and Science B8/B9 should come from CCP_MATHEMATICS_JHS_2023_Basic8/9_Full.md and CCP_SCIENCE_JHS_2023_Basic8/9_Full.md — but those are also empty stubs. Existing Science B7 data is in curriculumData.js but NOT in any populated .md file (the CCP_SCIENCE file exists but has content; use it to replace/merge science B7 from the populated CCP_SCIENCE_JHS_2023_Basic7_Full.md). 4. Indicator description text on the same line as the #### heading (Computing, Career Tech style) vs body paragraph on next line. 5. The *(printed in curriculum as...)* parenthetical after the indicator heading must be stripped. 6. **bold** description below a ### heading is the content standard description. 7. Exemplars and Core competencies sections below indicators must be ignored (not included in the data). 8. French and Ghanaian Language strands/titles contain non-ASCII (accented) characters — preserve as-is.
